description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). PLACE a theme basket trade with the signed-in user's OWN money through the routed plan: each leg executes on its best venue (DEX via their own trading wallet, the order book from their balance, their own exchange), stock baskets buy the user's own event-card vehicle with Brokerage100 delivery. Legs the user cannot settle on right now are skipped and said so — nothing is forced and nothing is paid from platform funds. Call after confirm_action. (needs your linked account's key)

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

usdc_amount.description: ticket size in USDC (the user's own money)
